test_eval_statements: test the pybind11 eval module to evaluate multiple Python statements and capture printed output
test_eval_single: test the pybind11 eval module to evaluate a single Python expression and return the result
test_eval_single_statement: test the pybind11 eval module to evaluate a single Python statement and verify success
test_eval_file: test the pybind11 eval module to evaluate Python code from a given file path
test_eval_failure: test the pybind11 eval module to handle evaluation failures and return False on error
